text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

You and the successful candidate are both women, so sex can't explain why she was chosen over you. An all-female panel tells you nothing here, and raising it would likely hurt your credibility.

The more relevant question may be **age**. She has eight years' experience to your fifteen, so she may be younger. That alone proves nothing, since panels often weigh client relationships and leadership style over tenure. But if anything in your interviews touched on age, "energy," "long-term fit," or "fresh perspective," write it down now.

Next step: follow up in writing on your request for an explanation, and ask for feedback on how the candidates were assessed against the criteria. The response, or a continued silence, will tell you more.
